what: The public demo's scenes, each said in Andy's own voice (SeamlessM4T v2)

start.text: Here's your room, measured in 3D. Now, what do you lose most often? Your keys, your glasses, your phone, the remote?

found.text: There it is! I see your blue mug: ahead of you, on your left, about 2 steps from you, at your 11 o'clock.

turned.text: Good news: your mug turned up! It's a little to my right, about 4 feet away. I'd been looking out for it since 9:40.

sound.text: I can hear it, but I can't see it. It's ringing a little to my left, where I'm pointing: it may be under something.

home.text: They live there, in the bowl by the door.

told.text: You told me on Friday at 3:12: your passport is in the top drawer of the desk. If it isn't there, ask me again and I'll look around the room.

checked.text: Mostly fine, but 1 thing isn't working. Telling how far (MapAnything): I can still find things and point, but not say how far.

mine.text: Found it! I see your mug, the one you showed me, a little to my right. The other mug isn't yours.

cups.text: Yes! I kept my eye on it. That's 2 to 1 to me. Again?

out.text: Don't forget your keys. I didn't see your glasses and your remote where I last saw them, so I hope they're with you. Remember: at 9:39, call Sam. Take an umbrella. Have a lovely time!

spanish.text: Veo su taza azul, un poco a mi derecha.

mandarin.text: 我看到您的蓝色杯子，在我右边一点。

web.text: The TV is showing Wikipedia's page on banana bread: a sweet quick bread made from mashed bananas.

answer.text: Sunny tomorrow, with a high of 61 and a light breeze in the afternoon. That's according to weather.gov.

drawing.text: Here's your picture, on the screen. I've saved it in your Pictures folder.

memory.text: I'm keeping an eye on your keys and your glasses. It's on the screen.

room.text: Here's the room as I measured it, on the screen: your keys a little to my right, about 2 feet away; your glasses a little to my left, about 3 feet away; your cup a little to my right, about 3 feet away. Its shape only, never a picture.

story.text: Here's the story of your keys. At 8:12, I found them on the desk, behind the keyboard. At 10:42, you put them down on the shelf by the door. At 11:12, you picked them up. At 12:05, I saw them on the desk again. They usually end up on the desk, behind the keyboard. It's on the screen.

privacy.text: Today, 21 of your 24 requests stayed in this house. For the other 3, I sent 68 words to Muse Spark, and 2 screenshots of web pages you asked to see. No camera pictures and no sound left the house. It's on the screen.

promises.text: I never send a camera picture of your home to the cloud, I never give health advice, and I always say I'm an AI. And no camera picture has left this house today. It's on the screen, with the receipts.

help.text: I can find things and point at them, keep an eye on things, remind you, and look things up.

in-tl.text: Nakikita ko ang iyong asul na tasa, kaunti sa aking kanan.

in-vi.text: Tôi thấy chiếc cốc xanh của bạn, hơi lệch sang phải một chút so với tôi.

in-ko.text: 파란 컵이 보입니다. 제 오른쪽에 조금 있습니다.

in-ru.text: Я вижу вашу синюю чашку, чуть правее меня.

in-ar.text: أرى كوبك الأزرق، قليلًا إلى يميني.

in-hi.text: मैं आपका नीला कप देख रहा हूँ, वह मेरे दाएँ थोड़ा है।

in-pt.text: Eu vejo sua xícara azul, um pouco à minha direita.

in-fr.text: Je vois votre tasse bleue, un peu à ma droite.

in-it.text: Vedo la tua tazza blu, un po' alla mia destra.

in-pl.text: Widzę twój niebieski kubek, trochę po mojej prawej stronie.

in-de.text: Ich sehe Ihren blauen Becher, ein wenig zu meiner Rechten.

emergency.text: If you need help, please call 911 right away. I'll find your phone. There it is! I see your phone: ahead of you, on your left, about 2 steps from you, at your 11 o'clock.
